what_this_is: Phase 0 baseline: how the ORIGINAL Colab notebook (docs/Local_Agentic_RAG_System_PDF.ipynb) behaved, so later changes can be compared to it. Nothing below is a measurement yet.
how_to_fill: Open docs/Local_Agentic_RAG_System_PDF.ipynb in Colab and run it on data/sample_text_en.pdf.
Ask each question below. Copy the notebook's answer, the chunks it retrieved (page and text start), and the seconds it took into the matching entry.
Set status to 'recorded' and fill 'recorded_on' and 'environment' (Colab runtime, GPU or CPU).

questions.question: How much memory did the laptop have?
What passage size, in characters, was used?
What constant was used in reciprocal rank fusion?
What recall did hybrid search reach at five passages?
How many of the failures were caused by scanned pages?
How many files did the team collect?
How many tokens of output did the prompt allow?
What is the capital of France?
How much funding did the study receive?
